messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up — candidate Lior (senior ML) arriving 6/12 07:30 local (late red-eye). We have onsite interviews 10:00–16:00. Needs: wheelchair access, halal lunch, quiet room for a 1:1, and a loaner M1 Mac. Can we confirm badge + parking + loaner pickup?
Ben Howard: I can book the quiet room + meeting rooms. Which building/desk should we reserve for lunch seating?
Aisha Khan: Please reserve Conf C on 3 (wheelchair ramp right outside). Lunch booking for 12:30 — 2 people (panelist and candidate) at the table by the window.
Tara Li: I’ve got badge provisioning. Will pre-create a day badge and put it at the front desk. What name should be on it?
Aisha Khan: "Lior Patel" (as on passport). Also cc recruiter for flight reimbursement.
Mike Reynolds: Confirmed — I sent Lior the travel-stip email earlier, will re-send stipend + instructions for expense form.
PeopleOps Bot: Checklist created: badge, loaner, accessibility, dietary. ETA updates will be posted here. :white_check_mark:
Ben Howard: Loaner request — Tara, we have one M1 Mac in the pool. Do you want me to tag it and leave it in Locker A? Tagging note: `loaner:M1-42`
Tara Li: Yes please. I’ll label and add charger. Will anyone need SSH keys or corp VPN preinstalled?
Aisha Khan: Basic images only — Chrome, Zoom, Slack. No corp keys. Candidate will use a temporary VM for code tests.
Facilities: Parking pass reserved for Visitor Spot P2-7 from 06/12 06:00–06/13 18:00. Front desk notified re: accessibility ramp.
Tara Li: Badge will be ready by 08:30 and placed with the front desk under "Lior Patel". Loaner in Locker A-3 with code 4821 (I'll DM the front desk code).
Mike Reynolds: Reimbursements — I attached the quick guide to expenses in the DM to Lior and asked for receipts. Also confirmed the remote-panel fallback if their flight delays.
Aisha Khan: Scheduling note: panel 2 prefers to start at 10:15 if possible (one panelist has a 9am drop-in). Ben, can the first slot shift 15m?
Ben Howard: Yup — shifting initial 45m coding + 15m buffer. Updated calendar invite and pushed new times.
PeopleOps Bot: Calendar update posted: ics sent to Lior and interviewers. Invite link: https://calendar.company/ical/2060001234.
Tara Li: One more — dietary: halal + gluten-free option. Catering order placed.
Aisha Khan: Amazing — last thing, please confirm who is meeting Lior at the lobby. I can be there but flying in same morning so if I miss it can someone else pick up?
Ben Howard: I can meet them at 07:45 and escort to front desk if needed.
Mike Reynolds: I'll stand by to jump in if travel hiccups — will monitor flight and ping here.
PeopleOps Bot: Flight monitor set for LO-412; status: scheduled. Will post any gate/arrival updates here.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team — we should be good. Will follow up if recruiter confirms any itinerary changes. :pray:
